name: Adjustment 4
definition: Modification on the value of goods and / or services. For example: rebate, discount, surcharge.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Specifies the type of adjustment applied to the amount of goods/services by means of a code.

OtherAdjustmentType.name: Other Adjustment Type
OtherAdjustmentType.definition: Specifies a type of adjustment not present in the code list.

Direction.name: Direction
Direction.definition: Specifies whether the adjustment must be subtracted or added to the total amount.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Specifies the monetary amount of the adjustment.

TypeOrOtherAdjustmentTypeRule.definition: If Type is present, then OtherAdjustmentType is not allowed. If Type is not present, then OtherAdjustmentType is mandatory.
